cases.evidence_note: Stage 18 mutation scenario, predicted by hand and recorded: P7 with no advance payments. The exception for income below the poverty line needs advance payments (i8962 p. 9, "APTC was paid for the coverage of 1 or more months during 2025"), so the filer is not an applicable taxpayer and no credit is allowed.

Stage 18 adjudication regression (finding R2), predicted by hand: two policies from one state that follow one another (January to June, then July to December). Each month has one Form 1095-A, so each form's column B counts for its months (i8962 p. 16, "If you have more than one Form 1095-A showing coverage in a particular month"). Contribution $129 a month: column (e) is $350 for January to June and $150 for July to December; line 24 $3,000, advance payments $1,500.

Stage 18 adjudication regression (finding R1): blind return P8 (line 5 below 100) with an enrolled lawfully present alien not eligible for Medicaid because of immigration status. i8962 p. 9 makes such a filer an applicable taxpayer; decision D6 refuses the branch.

cite.locator: p. 9, Alien lawfully present in the United States, "Certain aliens with household income below 100% of the federal poverty line are not eligible for Medicaid because of their immigration status."

cases.evidence_note: Stage 18 adjudication regression (finding F1), predicted by hand: blind return P8 (Form 8962 line 29 $375, Form 1040 line 16 $0) with $200 of creditable foreign tax under the election without Form 1116. The limit is regular tax, i1116 p. 25, Line 20, "the total of Form 1040 ... line 16, and Schedule 2 (Form 1040), Part I, line 1z": $0 + $375, so the credit is $200 and line 22 $175.

Stage 18 mutation scenario, predicted by hand: two Forms 1095-A from one state, both covering every month on the monthly route; only the first form's column B is counted (i8962 p. 16, "Enter the amount from column B of only one Form 1095-A"). Contribution $129 a month: column (a) $500, column (b) $500, column (d) $371, column (e) $371 each month; line 24 $4,452, advance payments $3,000.

Stage 18 mutation scenario: Schedule 2 line 3 refuses on its own screen for other Schedule 2 taxes (s2.other) even when Form 8962, read through line 1z, also refuses (an allocation, f8962.alloc). The screen order is the evidence: s2.amt, then s2.other, before the lines summed.

s2.line3.remedy: Prepare the other required tax forms; this slice supports only Schedule SE and Forms 8959 and 8960.
